question: Which of the following statements defines Formula Unit?

options.text: Sum of atomic masses of all atoms in the formula unit of an ionic compound
Mass of one mole of a compound

solution:
The correct answer is __**Sum of atomic masses of all atoms in the formula unit of an ionic compound**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Formula Unit:** A formula unit in chemistry refers to the simplest ratio of ions represented in an ionic compound. It highlights the composition of a compound without detailing its molecular structure.
 
• **Definition:** The formula unit mass is the **sum of the atomic masses of all atoms in the formula unit of an ionic compound**. This is the correct definition that matches the question's context.
 
• **Examples:** For sodium chloride (NaCl), the formula unit mass is calculated by adding the atomic mass of sodium (23) and chlorine (35.5), which equals 58.5.
